script = '''
import fitz  # PyMuPDF
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io
import json

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)

# --- Part 1: Extract text from ALL pages ---
all_text = {}
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    text = page.get_text()
    all_text[f"page_{i+1}"] = text

print("=" * 60)
print("PART 1: EXTRACTED TEXT FROM PDF (all pages)")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"Total pages: {len(doc)}")
for page_key, text in all_text.items():
    print(f"\\n--- {page_key} ---")
    print(text[:3000] if len(text) > 3000 else text)
    if len(text) > 3000:
        print(f"... [truncated, total {len(text)} chars]")

# --- Part 2: OCR on the first page image ---
print("\\n" + "=" * 60)
print("PART 2: OCR ON FIRST PAGE IMAGE")
print("=" * 60)

first_page = doc[0]
# Render page to image at 300 DPI for good OCR quality
mat = fitz.Matrix(300/72, 300/72)
pix = first_page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)
img_data = pix.tobytes("png")
img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_data))

# Save the first page image
img.save("output/first_page.png")
print(f"First page image saved to output/first_page.png (size: {img.size})")

# Perform OCR
ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
print(f"\\nOCR Text from first page:\\n")
print(ocr_text)

doc.close()
'''
